_notes: Written copy for the offline path - the path that runs when no Claude API key is set,
which for this account is every scheduled run. The generic fallback in
app/ai/copywriter.py exists so the system never fabricates a claim; it is safe but it
is not marketing. These lines are the same guarantee with a writer behind it.
* every factual claim must already be true in the client profile (proof_points,
products, service_area). Nothing new is asserted here.
* no superlatives, no price promises, no insurance-claim language - see
* headlines are written to be set in condensed caps at 2-4 words per line.
* `support` finishes the thought the headline starts; it never restates it.
Selection is deterministic: campaign + date + slot picks the variant, so a batch never
repeats itself and a week never repeats a day.
